text:
Zoe: Heads-up i pushed a small PR to standardize SOC2 phrasing in the audit export guide and to add a short python snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1899
Mike: thanks. are we changing the retention wording too? last reviewer flagged "deleted immediately" as risky.
Zoe: yeah swapped that to: "records expire and are purged per tenant (customer-owned namespace) TTL; legal hold preserves records until release." also added a one-line note about exports respecting tenant TTLs unless legal hold applies.
Mike: can you paste the python example? quick sanity check.
Zoe: sure:
```py
from redwood import AuditClient
import os
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.export_evidence(tenant_id='acme-co', pseudonymize=True, time_window=('2025-10-01','2025-10-31'))
```
Zoe: sample output in doc now shows `pseudonymized_user_id`, `event_ts`, `action`, `resource`. added a tiny mapping table too.
legal-ops: prefer explicit sentence: "Identifiers are pseudonymized using an irreversible, tenant-specific HMAC; timestamps and audit metadata are retained for evidentiary purposes." also request we avoid the word "mask" alone.
Zoe: swapped wording and added a short ops note about exports being uploaded to a presigned S3 object over TLS and encrypted with SSE-KMS by default.
devex-bot: Reminder: docs checklist 5 5 add CODEOWNERS, include snippet tests, and update changelog.
Mike: LGTM, will review the PR after legal sign-off.
Zoe: thanks everyone, i'll push the tiny follow-ups now :thumbsup:
